messages: Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Archer, I feel the urge to learn more.
Does #b#p221##k of #b#m10001000##k have even greater lessons to teach me?
#b#p221##k said that if I can pass her test, she'll gladly teach me more. I'm no longer the weakling I once was, but hearing that I still have to face a trial makes me a bit nervous.
name: The Bowman's Next Journey
